en: Udāna 3.4 Sāriputtasutta Thus have I heard:
On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now on that occasion the Venerable Sāriputta was sitting not far from the Blessed One, having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness before him.
The Blessed One saw the Venerable Sāriputta sitting not far away, having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness before him.
Then the Blessed One, having understood this matter, on that occasion uttered this inspired exclamation:
Thus, through the destruction of delusion,
a bhikkhu does not tremble, like a mountain.
